blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Xicpatla nochi inezca achi tlahtolli itic occe tlahtolli.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: xicquixti cactoc yeyan ipan ome inacaz
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Xiccuepa ce tlahtolli icopinaliz ica cactoc yeyan tlaquixtilli ipan ce noso ome itlamiliz.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Quitlalia inin tlapatlani ma san ce ica calaquiliztli.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Ce tlapatlani itocayo '%1' ye onca ica occe nemiliztli: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Ce tlapatlani itocayo '%1' ye onca quen calaquiliztli ipan tlachiuhcayotl '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Ce tepantli itech tetl%2 ipan tequitiloyan.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Xictemo ipan tequitiloyan. Xictlacui Enter ic occe tlanamiquiliztli, Shift+Enter ic tlanamiquiliztli achtopa. Xictlacui Escape ic tictzacuaz temoliztli ihuan tictlachiliz tlanamiquiliztli axcan.
bots-none: Ayamo onca tepoztlacameh. Ce tepoztlacatl ce tlatequipanoani ipan moservidor - ce AI tlatequipanoani, ce CI tequitl, ce script - in tlein inin huapalli quimaca amatlapalli.
card-archive-pop: Amatlapalli ayacmo monextiz ipan inin tocatlahtolli satepan ticuicas pixcalco.
card-archive-suggest-cancel: Satepan huel ticuepas amatlapalli ipan pixcalli.
click-to-unstar: Xictoca inic ticquixtilis icitlalmachiotl inin huapalli.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: In Cloud Panel zan ica SuperAdmin, ipan ichan Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ica WeKan ipan Weddy, in Cloud Panel quintlayecoltia miac WeKan domain ce servidor ipan, cecentetl ica itlahcuilol. Ipan ichan Cloud Panel, in SuperAdmin quinyacana in domain ihuan CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ica ce CloudFlare API tlatlapoloni, ce domain tlen izona ca ipan mocuenta CloudFlare quiceliz ce DNS tlahcuilolli ica proxy ihuan ce CloudFlare Origin amatl. Occequintin domain quiceliah ce Let's Encrypt amatl. In tlatlapoloni motlatia ipan servidor ihuan ayic occeppa monextiz.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Amo onca CloudFlare API tlatlapoloni omotlati: cecentetl domain quiceliz ce Let's Encrypt amatl.
creator: Chihqui
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Occequintin tlaquetzalli ic mocalaquizqueh quen tlahtolli monemac tlaltin:
csv-mapping-description: Xicpehpena tlanamactli itlaquetzal tlen quipia sesen amatlapalli itlal. Tlapehpenaliztli ochihualoc ica tlaquetzalli intocayo; xicpatla tlen amo melahuac, ihuan xicpehpena (amo ipan tlanamactli) para ce tlalli tlen tlanamactli amo quipia.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Tlanamactli amo quipia tlaquetzalli para tocatlahtolli. Xicpehpena ce icpac, noso xictlahcuilo itocayo inon san ce tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli.
csv-mapping-list-required: Xictlahcuilo itocayo tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli, noso xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia tocatlahtolli.
csv-mapping-title-required: Xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia amatlapaltin intocayo.
custom-field-stringtemplate-item-placeho: Xicpacho Enter ic ticcalaquiz occe tlamantli
delete-all-notifications-confirm: ¿Tictemaca tiquinpolos mochi tenahuatiliztin? Inin tlachihualiztli amo huel mocuepas.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Tlamacaliztli amo huel moneltili; xictlachili achtopa ticyehyecoz occepa
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Tlaseliani amo onca noso itequiuh amo tequiti

email-recovery-attempts: Oc ceppa tlayehyecoliztli itlapohual cenca hueyi
email-recovery-busy: Titlaniliztli noso oc ce tequitl ipan tocatlahtolli ye mochihua. Xicyancuicili ihuan xicyehyeco oc ceppa achitzin zatepan.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Ticnequi ticpolos nochi tlahcuilolli tlen axcan quichia ipampa inin tlaseliani? Tlen itech onca mopoloz ihuan amo huel mocuepaz. Tlahcuilolli yancuic tlen mochihua zatepan inin tlahtlaniliztli mopiyaz.
email-recovery-description: Ce tlahcuilolpantli ipampa ceceyaca tlaseliani. Xictemo ica tequitiliani i-ID. Amo monextia tlahcuilolli itech onca tlamantli niyon tlaseliani itlahcuilol tlanextiloyan. Quetzaliztli quipiya tlahcuilolli tlen axcan onca ihuan tlen zatepan yez; oc ceppa pehualiztli quiyehyecoa axcan quititlaniz tlahcuilolli tlen quichia. Pololiztli quipoloa tlahcuilolli tlen omotlali ipan tocatlahtolli achto noso ipan tlahtlaniliztli icahuitl. Intla titlaniliztli ye mochihua, xicyehyeco oc ceppa achitzin zatepan. Tlahcuilolli tlen ye motitlania amo huel mocuepa, ihuan intla amo machi intla oahcic, huel oc ceppa motitlaniz. Tlahcuilolli tlen nochipa amo huel motitlania ihuan tlen oahcic tlayehyecoliztli itlamiyan oc mopiya inic motlachiliz. Oc ceppa titlaniliztli pehua yancuic tlayehyecoliztli ihuan quipiya quetzaliztli tlen ye onca.
email-recovery-empty: Amo onca tlahcuilolli tlen quichia niyon tlaselianimeh tlen intitlaniliz omoman.
email-recovery-failed: Amo ohuel moneltili tequitl. Xicyancuicili tocatlahtolli ihuan intla monequi, xicyehyeco oc ceppa in yehuatl tequitl.
email-recovery-retry: Xicyehyeco oc ceppa xictitlani tlahcuilolli tlen amo ohuel motitlan
email-recovery-retrying: Tlahcuilolli tlen oc ceppa moyehyecoa quititlaniz
email-recovery-superseded: Tequitiliani iyancuic tequiuh oquipatla inin tlahtlaniliztli. Monextia quen axcan cah tocatlahtolli.
email-recovery-unavailable: Amo huel mopohua tlahcuilolli itocatlahtol. Xiquitta tlayecani icalaquiliz ihuan intla tepospalehuiani huel tequiti.

error-json-schema: MoJSON tlanextilli amo quipia cualli tlahtolli ipan cualli machiyotl
error-ldap-login: Ce ahcuallotl omochiuh ihcuac oquinec calaquini
error-notAuthorized: Amo ticpia cahuiliztli inic tiquittaz inin amatl.
error-user-notSameOrgOrTeam: Zan huel ticcalaquiz tlacah ipan san ce nechicoliztli noso tlanechicolli
export-card-details: Amatlapalli tlanonotzaltin (cece amatlapalli quen amatlapalli quixtiliztli)
filter-on-desc: Tiquinchipahua amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli. Xictoca nican inic ticpatlas tlachipahualiztli.
import-attachment-auth-hint: In tlaquixtiliztli quintocaitia itlanamictilhuan, zan amo quinhuica in amatl. Inic quinhuicaz, xictlali in itlacuilol in tequitl ihuan in calaquiliztli: zan ipampa inin calaquiliztli motequiuhtia, zan oncan motitlani, ihuan aic mopia. Xiccahua ahtle inic tiquincalaquiz ahmo amatl.
import-attachment-auth-token: API tlanexcayotl, API tlatzacuilli noso ichtaca tlahtolli app
import-board-instruction-asana: Xicpepecho ce Asana tequitl tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "data": [...] } itech Asana tlaquixtilli noso GET /tasks). Tequitl monechicoa ipan secciones (memberships); tequitl tlamic yauh Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ipan Businessmap (achtopa Kanbanize), xictlapo Advanced Search, xicpehpena Configure results ic tiquinpehpenaz tlaquetzalli, xictemohui Excel tlanamactli, satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mopohuah ica intocayo ipan inglés (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): intla motequiuh quitequihuia occe tlahtolli, achtopa xicpatla tzontecomatl tlahcuilolpan ipan inglés. Column mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan Lane ohtin; tecuhtin, machiotl, tlapalli, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tetahtzin ilpiliztli quipiah inyeyan, ihuan Priority, Size, Type ihuan occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ipan ClickUp, xiquinquixti tequitl quen CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noso ce List noso Table tlachializtli iquixtiliz ica nochtin tlaquetzalli), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, ClickUp tocatlahtoltin mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequitonhuan, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, achtopayotl ihuan cahuitl.
import-board-instruction-csv: Xicpepecho moComma Separated Values (CSV) / Tab Separated Values (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Xicpepecho ce NextCloud Deck huapalli JSON (ce huapalli ica "stacks", sesen stack quipia "cards"). Stacks mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan cards mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-excel: Xicpehpena ce WeKan-machiyotl .xlsx tlapoualtlacuilolli (san se columnas quemeh Excel tlaquixtilli: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Achto fila cah tlacpac tocayotl.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Xictlapo in .boardarchive amatl ihuan xicpepecho in huapalli board.jsonl, ica nozo amo ica in versión itlahuipan. In huapalli itlachiyaliz in tlein quinechicoa mochihua tocatlahtoltin; occe tlamantli tlein huel ticpehpena mochihua machiotl. In tlahcuilolli ihuan in nauhcampa tlein ticmachiotia imaxelol mochihua tlahtolli ihuan tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli; tlahtolpehualiztin mocahuilia. Ixiptlahuan ihuan amatl tlein motlalilia amo calaqui.
import-board-instruction-issues: Xicpepecho ce __sourceName__ ahcuallotl JSON tlatecpanalli (__endpoint__). Ahcuallotin mocuepah amatlapaltin tlatecpanaltin ipan Open / Closed tocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Xicpepecho ce Kanboard tlaquixtilli JSON: ce tlamantli ica "columns" (noso tequitl ica column_name) ihuan ce "tasks" tlatecpanalli (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tasks mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ipan Kanri, xictlapo Import & Export ihuan xicpehpena Export individual board (noso Export all data), satepan xictlali .json tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapaltin mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahtol, tlamiliztonalli, machiotl ihuan tlapalli; ce amatlapalli itequiuh mocuepa tlanextiliztocatlahtolli. Ipan ce nochi tlapializtli iquixtiliz mocalaquia achtopa huapalli.
import-board-instruction-leo: Xicpepecho in Leo tlatecpanaliztli (.leo tlahcuilolli). In tlamantli tlacpac cateh mocuepah tocatlahtolli, in impilhuan mocuepah amatlapalli, ihuan in tlamantli itlahcuilol mochihua amatlapalli itlahtol. In tlamantli oc achi tlatzintlan cateh mocuepah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli. In tlamantli machiyotia motlaliah iuhquin ye otlanqueh.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ipan Linear, xiquinquixti tlahtlaniliztli quen CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noso ce tlachializtli iquixtiliz), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tlanechicolli mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intlanahuatil, machiotl, tonalli, tetahtzin tlahtlaniliztli, achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, tequiyotl ihuan cuepaliztli.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Xitlali ce markdown tequitl tlanechicolli (in nescayotl tlen tequitl markdown-kanban iuhqui Obsidian Kanban quitequitiltia): "## Tlanechicolli itoca" tlahtolpani, ihuan "- [ ]"/"- [x]" tlamantli tlatzintlan. Tlahtolpani mocuepa tlanechicolli ihuan tlamantli mocuepa amamachiotl.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ipan MeisterTask, xictlacui tequiyotl itocayo, xicpehpena Export project ihuan xicquixti CSV, satepan xictlali. Xeloliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, tlamiliztonalli, tlanahuatilli ihuan machiotl; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal. Ce CSV tlahcuilolli para MeisterTask icalaquiliz no tequiti.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ipan monday.com, xictlapo huapalli itlaahxitiliz, xicpehpena More actions ihuan Export board to Excel (ica yancuiliztli ihuan tlamantontli intla ticnequi), satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Status tlaquetzalli mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan nechicoliztli mocuepah ohtin; tlacah, tonalli, tonalcuepohualli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan, occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin ihuan yancuiliztli mocuepah tlahtolpehualiztli.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ipan Notion, xictlapo tlapializtli quen ce nochi amatl, xicpehpena ••• ihuan Export, xicpehpena Markdown & CSV, ihuan xicpehpena .zip tlanamactli tlen motemohuia, noso ce tlapializtli CSV tlen itech quiza, noso xictlali inon CSV. Ce tlaquetzalli itocayo Status mocuepa tocatlahtoltin (intla amo onca, iachtopa tlaquetzalli tlen monextia quen tlapehpenaliztli, ihuan icalaquiliz tlanonotzaliztli quihtoa catlehhuatl); tlahcuilolpan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intocayo, machiotl, tlacah quen tlacah ipan amatlapalli, tonalli, ihuan amatl itlahcuilol quen tlahtolli; occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Netechpanoliztli, tlachialoni ihuan tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ipan Nullboard, xictlapo huapalli, xicpehpena Export this board... ipan tlaahxitiliztli, xictlapo .nbx tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni ihuan xictlali tlen quipia. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tlahcuilolli mocuepah amatlapaltin: ce tlahcuilolli iachtopa tlahcuilolpan yez amatlapalli itocayo ihuan occe yez itlahtol. Ce tlahcuilolli raw quiselia machiotl raw. Ce tlanamactli ica miec huapaltin quicalaquia iachtopa huapal.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ipan Obsidian, xictlapo Kanban huapalli itlanamac quen Markdown (noso xictlapo .md tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni), satepan xictlali mochi. Ohtin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ica inamatlapalhuan itlamiliz, amatlapaltin quipiah inmachiohuan, tonalli, achtopayotl, tlaltin ihuan tlanextiliztocatlahtolli, ihuan Archive mocuepa amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Xicpepecho ce OpenProject work-packages nechicoliztli JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan work packages mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-opml: Xictlali ce OPML tlanextiliztli, quen quiquixtiah Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ihuan occequintin. Achtopa tlamantli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, inpilhuan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica tlahcuilolli quen tlahtolli, ihuan tlamantli tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin. Tlamantli tlamiltin mocalaquiah quen otlan.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Xictlali ce Org mode tlanamactli, quen quitlahcuiloah Emacs, Orgzly noso Beorg. Achtopa tzontecomatl mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan ic ome tzontecomatl mocuepah amatlapaltin. TODO ihuan DONE, achtopayotl, machiotl, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ihuan CLOSED mopiah, ihuan tlamachiotiloni ihuan tzontecomatl tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ipan Pivotal Tracker, xictlapo tequiyotl iMORE tlaxeloliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV (noso xiquinpehpena tlaquetzaliztli ihuan xicpehpena Bulk Actions, CSV), satepan xictlali CSV. Sesen tlaquetzaliztli inemiliz mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlaquetzaliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica innemiliz ihuan machiotl, tecuhtin, tetlahtlaniani, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli, tequitl ihuan tlatzacuiliztli; Estimate mocuepa Story points ihuan cuepaliztli mocuepah sprints.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ipan Plane, xictlapo Workspace Settings, xicpehpena Exports, xiquinquixti tequiyotl quen JSON, CSV noso Excel ihuan xictemohui .zip tlanamactli, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli, noso ce tlanamactli tlen itech ca, noso xictlali JSON noso CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tequiyotl mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica inmachiyo, tetahtzin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, ilpiliztli ihuan tlahtolpehualiztli; achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, cuepaliztli ihuan module mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Plane iquixtiliz amo quipia tlahtolli noso tlanamictilli, ic amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ipan Quire, xictlapo tequiyotl itlaahxitiliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV, satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intequitonhuan quen amatlapalpipiltin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, pehualiztonalli, tlamiliztonalli ihuan tlantzontonalli, tlahtolli ihuan achtopayotl quen monemac tlalli. Tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tlanamictilli amo cateh ipan Quire iCSV.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ipan Redmine, xictlapo tequiyotl iIssues, xicpehpena Also available in: CSV itzintlan tocatlahtolli, xiquinpehpena tlaquetzalli (All columns, ica Description) ihuan xicquixti, satepan xictlali CSV. Redmine quintocayotia tlaquetzalli ipan motlahtol, ic xictlali motlahtol ipan inglés ipan My account achtopa ticquixtiz. Sesen nemiliztli mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica tracker quen machiotl, tlanahuatilli, tlachiuhqui, tonalli, tetahtzin tequitl ihuan tlahtlaniliztli tlen monetechpanoah; achtopayotl, tlamantli, tlaneltoquilli tlapatlaliztli, cahuitl tlatemachilli, % Done ihuan monemac tlaltin mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ipan Super Productivity, xictlapo Settings, satepan Sync & Backup, xicpehpena Export Data ihuan xictlali tlen quipia sp-backup .json tlanamactli. Sesen tequiyotl mocuepa ohtli ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan To Do, In Progress, Backlog noso Done, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tlamiliztonalli, cahuitl tlen opanoc ihuan tequitontli; tequitl ipan pixcalli mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ipan Taiga, xictlapo Admin > Project > Export ihuan xictemohui tequiyotl itlapializ (achtopa xictlapo ce .json.gz tlanamactli), satepan xictlali iJSON. User story nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, user stories mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequiuh quen tequitontli, epics ihuan tlahtlaniliztli quipiah inohhuan, ihuan sprints, machiotl, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan monemac tlamantli no huallauh. Tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ipan Tasks.org, xictlapo Settings, Backups ihuan xicpehpena Export tasks, satepan xictlali tlen quipia inon .json tlanamactli. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tequitontli; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal, ihuan achtopayotl mocuepa monemac tlalli.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Xicpepecho in tlein quiza ipan task export: ce JSON tlahuipantli, nozo ce tequitl ipan cece tlahuipantli. In tequitl tlamitoc yahui ipan Done; project ihuan priority mochihua machiotl, annotations mochihua tlahtolpehualiztin, ihuan depends quimotitia in tequitl tlein quitzacua occe tequitl.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ipan Teamwork.com, xictemiti Excel tequitl icalaquiliz neixcuitilli (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ihuan xicpiya quen .xlsx, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli. Tequitl itocatlahtol mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin; ce tequitl tlen pehua ica -, # noso > mocuepa itequiton tequitl tlen icpac ca (--, ## noso >> ce tlamantli oc temo). Tlanahuatiltin, tonalli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan; Priority, Estimated time ihuan Complete mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ipan TickTick, xictlapo Settings, Account, Backup & Import ihuan xicchihua ce tlapializtli, satepan xictlali CSV tlanamactli.
